author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing was a ring floating over a bowl with a tiny stub under the rim, and it read as a ball over a soup bowl. There was no body. Redrawn after the reference: the bather's head and a rounded shoulder dome rise out of the tub above the rim, with the head 8 above the shoulders, over the round bowl tub, so it reads as a person sitting in the bath.
omissions: The arm resting along the rim was dropped. A hand lobe on the rim fails the hole gate, and a stroke arm read as a sail.
